semantics.note: The normalization preserves the retrospective doubt and six-month interval. It remains a hedged assessment, not a categorical assertion.

contract.note: The contract appropriately declines to supply an unstated profit measure or convert doubt into certainty.

reviews.rationale: Explicit doubt is not scored under the policy. Service profitability also lacks a defined measure. These limitations do not make the case broken.

attribution.note: Zitron directly endorses the payment forecast.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the July commencement, monthly amount, annualized equivalent, and additional compute arrangements.

contract.note: Treating payment as the monthly charge commencing in July is an ordinary reading. Requiring evidence of implementation fairly distinguishes the outcome from the announced schedule.

evidence.note: The May report records company confirmation of planned terms. It cannot establish that the full charge subsequently commenced in July.
The October report asserts July commencement but refers back to the May filing without identifying subsequent verification. Under the contract, this does not establish implementation.

reviews.rationale: July has passed, but the packet establishes the announced schedule rather than verified commencement. The retrospective report favors the forecast but supplies no identifiable new verification; continued operation of all named arrangements is also unestablished. Neither support nor contradiction is settled.
